restaurantName: Hu Er Ge Yao Shan Ti Hua
address: 146-19, Section 1, Yi Huan West Road, Qingyang, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: The simple shop has little ambiance to speak of, but that hasn't put hungry locals off from flocking here since 1999. In fact, it's the favourite late-night spot for many who come for its famous pork trotter soup – simmered with Chinese herbs for eight hours until the connective tissues are gelatinous and the soup is loaded with collagen. Stir-fries such as spicy chitterlings, and green chilli pig snout fried rice are also brimming with wok hei....
pageTitle: Hu Er Ge Yao Shan Ti Hua
